description: April 7 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 7 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The April 7 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: A thinker's number in a doer's sign: April 7 carries the 7, the number of reflection, and places the Sun around seventeen degrees into Aries. With the Sun sub-ruling the decan, confidence remains, but it turns inward. The tradition sketches a proud, independent mind that prefers to reach its conclusions alone and defend them with spirit.

Astronomically, April 7 puts the Sun near 17° Aries in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Sun. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 7
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 7 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 7 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 7 is the 97th day of the year (98th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 13 days, by April 20.

By April 7 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 7 birthday are Jackie Chan (1954), William Wordsworth (1770) and Gabriela Mistral (1889).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 7?
faq.answer: April 7 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 7 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 7?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 7, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 7?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 7 include Jackie Chan (1954), William Wordsworth (1770) and Gabriela Mistral (1889). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
